notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-KISIN-PAPPAS-ZHOU-26 by Claude Code, session cc-2aeb03; the extraction was written by Codex (codex-c83e7a, #1683) and completed by Claude Code (cc-442dc5, #2141). The published Forum Math. Pi PDF (89 pages) was downloaded from Cambridge Core and read in full on page images in six ranges, against every item; arXiv v3, the latest version, was compared where the printed text was in doubt. Its SHA-256 differs from the extraction's record because Cambridge stamps each download. Corrected in place: 199 item fields (96 statements, 96 locators, 6 names, 1 kind) and 2 notes; six items removed as not in the paper (F31; P11; I06, I08, I09 and I10, which are steps inside DvHKZ's proofs that the paper does not cite); 88 items added for definitions, constructions and cited inputs the proofs use; four items made planned (Hodge- and abelian-type data at ShimuraData D4, the lattice-chain building at ReductiveGroupsPartII RG2.2–RG2.3, Néron–Ogg–Shafarevich at NeronModelsAndSemistableAbelianVarieties R11.5); three Part II titles set to their parents' exact atlas titles; route 6's brief rewritten and route 7's clarified; prerequisites rebuilt as 43 cited works with DOIs or stable links. Statuses: all 14 library declarations opened at the pinned commits and all planned stages checked in the atlas. Mistakes: E1–E14 confirmed (E6 revised: the quotation is the published p. 205 and it is H, not H^♯, that may fail the condition; E9 revised to an error whose reach is kept at a stated result, with a proposed repair recorded; E10 and E12 widened to further places with the same slip). 77 new claims were checked a second time, independently: 68 confirmed, 5 reclassified, 4 rejected; with one found by an independent check they are E15–E88. The main new ones: Proposition 3.4.6 needs H classical (E36); Proposition 6.3.2 needs a twisted cocharacter (E69); the proofs of Theorem 6.1.9 (E62) and Corollary 6.3.5 (E71) use a wrong dual and a non-chain; the paragraph after Definition 7.2.7 is false (E79), leaving gaps in Propositions 7.2.10 (E81) and 7.2.16 (E84). The main theorems (Theorems 1.1.1 = 7.2.21 and 1.2.3 = 4.4.3, Corollary 7.2.24) are not affected.
